metas.name: Nocturne
metas.description:
S1 E4–5 · out Thu 19 Nov

When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

metas.name: This City Is Ours
metas.description:
S2 E1–8 · out Mon 16 Nov

After trying to leave a world of crime, Michael is dragged back into the fold to answer questions. Back in Liverpool tensions continue to bubble amongst the remaining members of the gang, and a gangster who's just been let out of prison wants answers.
